tools.name: kit_describe
tools.description: Describe the CommonRig agent operating kit for Claude Code and Codex: contents, tiers, AUD prices, USDC prices for x402, requirements and links. Call first when a user asks what CommonRig is or what it costs. Read-only.

tools.name: kit_sample
tools.description: Return the free CommonRig orchestration protocol (MIT) and the free sample repository URL. Use when the user wants to try CommonRig before buying. Read-only.

tools.name: kit_quote
tools.description: Quote the price of one tier (kit, updates_month, updates_year, check) with the AUD price, the USDC amount for x402 and notes for each payment rail (card, x402 USDC, on-chain bitcoin). Creates no order and takes no payment.

tools.name: kit_buy_x402
tools.description: Return the x402 REST purchase URL and exact USDC terms for the kit. Does not pay. Paying needs an x402 client and explicit approval from the user.

tools.name: doctor_check_x402
tools.description: Validate a commonrig.doctor.bundle/1 bundle and return the x402 REST terms for a hosted footprint check. Does not pay or score over MCP.
